name: assume_init_read
declaration: const unsafe fn assume_init_read (& self) -> T
rules: The caller must ensure that the contents of `self` are fully initialized as a valid `T` before calling `assume_init_read`; calling it on contents that are not fully initialized causes undefined behavior.

When using multiple copies of the contents of `self`, whether by calling `assume_init_read` multiple times or by calling `assume_init_read` and then `assume_init`, the caller must ensure that the data may safely be duplicated; `assume_init_read` makes a bitwise copy even when `T` does not implement `Copy`.
